## Outcome

The existing Langfuse service receives bounded Open Brain lifecycle and aggregate recall-quality observations without receiving user or memory content.

## Acceptance

- closed content_free_observation.v1 allowlist and pure receipt mapper
- runtime, operation, status/mode, durability, bounded timing/error categories, contract identity, counts, and pseudonymized correlation only
- explicit rejection of prompts, queries, bodies, transcripts, distilled content, citations with bodies, paths, tool parameters/results, headers/tokens, arbitrary metadata, and exception strings
- disabled-by-default bounded fail-open exporter from validated direct-provider receipts, never mcp2cli audit logs
- Vaultwarden-backed endpoint/project credentials and pinned/live-verified Langfuse v3 ingestion contract
- sentinel leakage tests and an authenticated metadata-only canary proving input/output/body fields are absent
- Langfuse failure cannot change recall, write, spool, receipt, or gate outcomes
- Hermes remains not applicable
